Mannai Corp QSC Reports Steady Growth in Q1 Amidst Stable Market Conditions

Mannai Corp QSC, a leading player in Qatar’s Technology Services sector, has posted its routine trade figures for the first quarter of 2024, reflecting continued stability and moderate growth in line with industry expectations. The company recorded a 4.2% increase in revenues year-on-year, reaching QAR 612 million, compared to QAR 587 million in the same period last year. Net profit for the quarter stood at QAR 48.3 million, a 3.7% rise from Q1 2023.

The results underscore the resilience of Qatar’s technology services sector, which has benefited from sustained demand in both public and private sectors. “Our Q1 performance reaffirms Mannai Corp QSC’s strong market position and the trust of our clients,” said Sami Al-Khalaf, Chief Financial Officer. “We continue to focus on operational efficiency and customer service, which have been critical to maintaining steady growth.”

Industry analysts attribute the stable performance to ongoing digital transformation initiatives across the region and increasing investments in IT infrastructure by Qatari enterprises. “We are seeing consistent project flows with government agencies and large corporates accelerating their adoption of cloud solutions and cybersecurity services,” noted Maha Al-Subaie, senior analyst at the Gulf Technology Forum. “Mannai’s diversified service portfolio positions it well to capture this demand.”

No significant disruptions were reported in the company’s operations or supply chain during the quarter. The Technology Services industry in Qatar remains unaffected by global supply constraints, thanks to established local partnerships and careful inventory management. “We have built strategic relationships with both local and international suppliers, ensuring business continuity and timely delivery of projects,” said Ahmed Jaber, Head of Supply Chain at the company.

Trade associations welcomed the results, with the Qatar Technology Services Council highlighting the sector’s role in supporting the country’s national development goals. “Stable performance from leading firms like Mannai contributes to the ongoing digitalization of Qatar’s economy,” said Council Chairperson Fatima Al-Naimi.

Looking ahead, Mannai Corp QSC plans to maintain its focus on expanding managed services and developing new digital solutions to address evolving client needs, while remaining committed to delivering shareholder value and supporting Qatar’s Vision 2030.
